item.title: Baptist Anderson names new chief medical officer
item.description: Baptist Anderson Regional Medical Center has named Dr. Hatem Mourad as its new chief medical officer. He will replace Dr. Keith Everett who retired on Feb. 28 after serving as the hospital’s CMO since 2019.

item.title: Carlton ‘Corky’ Palmer Scholarship Endowment at MCC completed
item.description: Carlton “Corky” Palmer built his baseball program on trust, discipline, and accountability. Former players and associates say those same lessons shaped their lives long after they left the field.

item.title: Sowashee celebrates with Spring Fling

item.title: Fred Smith’s legacy is one of civility, curiosity, and a world-class love of books
item.description: After a long and courageous battle with cancer, Fred Smith—who concluded his remarkable life and career at Mississippi State University’s Mitchell Memorial Library as the Rare Books Coordinator in the Special Collections division—died at his home in Starkville on Feb. 28.

item.title: MPD investigating Wednesday shooting
item.description: Meridian Police Department is investigating after a gunshot victim was found Wednesday in a traffic incident.

item.title: EMCC Lions earn conference-opening baseball doubleheader split at Holmes
item.description: The visiting Lions of East Mississippi Community College flipped the score during Tuesday’s MACCC baseball opener at Holmes by claiming a 10-8 nightcap win to earn a doubleheader split with the Bulldogs. Holmes prevailed over EMCC by the same score in the day’s opening game played at Charlie Donald Field.

item.title: JAKES hunt shapes the future of turkey hunting
item.description: It’s a moment in time that has a lasting effect. In that instant some are forever changed. Such was the case for me, and although it occurred many years ago, I can recall every detail as if it had happened just after sunrise this very morning.

item.description: Ochsner Rush Health is welcoming Dr. Allison McDonald to the Ochsner Rush OBGYN clinic, located at 1800 12th St., Meridian.

item.title: Jimmie Rodgers Talent Competition accepting submissions
